scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.setup: npm install --prefix server --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error && npm install --prefix client --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error
scripts.dev: npm run setup && npm run build && npm run dev --prefix server
scripts.dev:hmr: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
